_comment_capture_harnesses: The workflow-completion capture harness descends from the subagent-completion one (the same bounded-scroll-region defect class, fixed card by card, each PR single-purpose by policy), and the Azure DevOps one descends from capture-issue-radar-fixes.mjs -- it shares that file's gateway-free fixture-server preamble and its boot-endpoint block, which is what makes an Issue Radar surface capturable without a gateway at all. The md-edit-label harness descends from capture-pierre-files-tab.mjs the same way: it reuses that file's chromium resolution, probe assertion and frame-recording blocks against a different surface (the file viewer's mode toggle). The long-url-linkify harness descends from capture-cjk-autolink.mjs -- the same markdown-tokenization defect class photographed through the same fixture-served chat bubble, against a different linkify defect. The files above are exempt BY FILE, not by directory: the originals they descend from, and every other capture/script file, stay checked. Sharing a runner was considered and rejected -- each harness is a one-shot evidence generator pinned to its own card's testid, fixture, and assertions, and coupling them would make the next card's fix re-touch a merged PR's files. Remove an entry here the moment its file stops matching its sibling.
_comment_desk_companion: Companion and Mochi are two separately-shippable companion apps that descend from the same desktop-buddy codebase, so the files listed below start as near-copies of Mochi's. They are exempt BY FILE, not by directory: every other file in desk-companion is still checked, and any new file added there is checked from the moment it exists. Sharing this layer was considered and rejected -- each app is enabled, disabled and versioned on its own, and the two are expected to diverge (Mochi is agentic, Companion paces your day), so a shared module would couple two products that deliberately ship apart. Remove an entry here the moment its file stops matching Mochi's.
